# langsmith_org_member (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith organization member invitation. Creating this resource invites a user by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_org_member" "example" {
  email   = "user@example.com"
  role_id = langsmith_org_role.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the member to invite.

### Optional

- `full_name` (String) The full name of the member.
- `role_id` (String) The role ID to assign to the member.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the member/invitation.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID.
